【Enjoy Comfortable Cycling Experience】Mountain bikes are equipped with powerful shock absorber that can challenge all kinds of rough surfaces. Bicycle Specification

Frame: 18” steel Frame Fork: MTB Suspension Fork B.B SET: Bearing type Handlebar:Steel Tire: 27.5“*1.95 full balck tire Rim: Mag Alloy or Aluminiu Alloy Rims Brake: Disc Brake F/Derailleur:Shimano TZ 30 R/Derailleur:Shimano TZ-50 Shifter: Shimano EF-500 Freewheel:7 plus weight: 40lbs fits up to: 5'7"-6' Maximum weight capacity: 300 lbs

About install:

1.This bicycle arrives 85% assembled. You will need to install the pedals, front wheel, handlebar and air up the tires. 2. Rotate the fork for 180 degree before assemble the front wheel (the brake will be in front of the bike) 3. Pedal threads are different from left side and right side. L / R signs are marked on the spindle of the each pedal, make sure they are assembled on the right side (when you ride on the bike, left pedal on your left hand, right pedal on your right hand). The right side pedal has a right-hand thread(removes counterclockwise, installs clockwise). The left side pedal has a left-hand thread. Thread both pedals into the crank arms as far as you can by hand. 4.All tools are included in the package,no extra tools
